end.summary:
- Practised identifying digits in the thousands, hundreds, and ones places.
- Used 1245 and 4206 for place-value questions.
- Diya requested a game-based activity and stopped when tired.
- In 4206, Diya said “चार हजार दो सौ पैसठ” but then said “four thousand two hundred six”; the wording mix-up was not revisited.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value in four-digit numbers using picture and story prompts. Diya correctly identified the thousands digit in 1245 and the hundreds and ones digits, and identified 6 as the thousands digit in a new number. There was a mix-up while saying 4206 in Hindi; it was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, try a short hidden-digit game with numbers such as 3,507, asking Diya to find one place at a time.
